observations.text: HbA1c was 7.6% on the 2026-07-11 Diabetes Panel, down from 8.4% on 2026-04-12, though still above the listed reference range of 4.0-5.6%.

Fasting plasma glucose was 152 mg/dL on the 2026-07-11 Diabetes Panel, down from 171 mg/dL on 2026-04-12 and still flagged high against a 70-100 mg/dL reference. Estimated average glucose also fell, from 194 to 171 mg/dL.
The latest logged blood glucose reading was 153 mg/dL, and blood glucose, blood pressure (129/84) and weight (81.6 kg) have all been stable.
